full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for the case are that the plaintiff filed the aforesaid suit for a declaration that the certificate proceeding bearing Number 1017/68-69 filed in the court of the certificate officer, Dumuria and the sale thereunder are illegal, void and without jurisdiction and the auction sale was liable to be set aside. It is stated by the plaintiff that Haider Sk, and others were the owners of the disputed jama recorded in S.A. Khatian No. 44 of mouja Kanaidanga P.S. Dumuria, Dist. Khulna. The defendant No.3 initiated the aforesaid certificate proceeding against Haider Sk. and others on 15.4.68 for arrears of rent. The certificate debtors were dead before filing the certificate case and that the notice under section 7 and rule 46 of the P.D.R. Act and sale proclamation were not served upon the certificate debtors and the same were - suppressed fraudulently by the Defendant No. 1 in collusion with the process server. No notice under section 7 of the Act or under section 43 of the Act was issued or served and the defendant No. 1 managed to purchase the property worth Tk. 25,000/00 at a nominal sum of Tk. 440/00. The writ of delivery of possession was also not served on the suit land. It appears that auction purchaser took collusive return of possession on 18.5.70 but actually he did not go to actual physical possession of the property.
